rows.ja: 競合(相手の資料に記載)

companies.name: EQT
companies.sub: 投資会社(スウェーデン)

relations.text: 大株主で、保有比率に応じて取締役を最大2名指名できる
relations.text_en: Major shareholder with the right to nominate up to two directors depending on its stake

source.label: Waystar 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Further, EQT has the right to nominate to our board of directors (i) two nominees for so long as EQT beneficially owns 25% or greater of our then-outstanding common stock

companies.name: カナダ年金制度投資委員会

relations.text: 大株主で、5%以上を持つ限り取締役1名を指名できる
relations.text_en: Major shareholder that can nominate one director while it owns 5% or more

source.label: Waystar 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: CPPIB has the right to nominate to our board of directors one nominee for so long as CPPIB beneficially owns 5% or greater of our then-outstanding common stock.

relations.text: Waystarに出資し、Waystarの顧客の一部にも大きな持分を持つ
relations.text_en: Owns an interest in Waystar and significant interests in some of its clients

source.label: Waystar 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Bain Capital LP has an ownership interest in us and a significant interest in some clients for whom we provide software solutions.

source.label: Waystar 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: For example, we acquired Iodine in 2025, a trusted leader in AI-powered clinical intelligence

relations.text: TruBridgeが10-Kで、財務管理ソリューションの主な競合としてWaystarを挙げる
relations.text_en: TruBridge names Waystar among principal competitors for its financial health solutions

source.label: TruBridge 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors for Financial Health solutions include RelayHealth Corp, SSI Group, LLC, Quadax Inc., Change Healthcare Holdings, Inc., Availity, LLC, Waystar Technologies, Inc.

relations.text: Solventumが10-Kで、収益サイクル管理などの主な競合としてWaystarを挙げる
relations.text_en: Solventum names Waystar among principal competitors in revenue cycle management

source.label: Solventum 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Principal competitors include Optum, Microsoft (Nuance), Epic, Oracle (Cerner), Waystar, Athena

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
